v22-5.candidate: But take great care to do the commandments and the law which Moses the servant of the Lord commanded us to do: to love the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, to keep His commandments, to cling to Him, and to serve Him with all your mind and all your soul.”

v22-23.candidate: If we built ourselves an altar to depart from the Lord our God, to offer on it a sacrifice of whole burnt offerings or a sacrifice of deliverance, the Lord will require an account.

v22-27.candidate: but so that it may be a testimony between us and you, and between our generations after us, that we may perform service to the Lord before Him with our offerings and our sacrifices and our sacrifices of deliverance. Then your children shall not say to our children tomorrow, ‘You have no portion in the Lord.’

v22-29.candidate: May it never be that we turn away from the Lord in these present days, departing from the Lord by building an altar for offerings, salamin sacrifices, and a sacrifice of deliverance apart from the Lord’s altar before His tent.”

v22-24.candidate: But we did this out of concern about this matter, saying, ‘It is so that your children may not say to our children tomorrow, “What do you have to do with the Lord, the God of Israel?
